description: Renovate owns dependency version updates (npm and GitHub Actions). Dependabot is kept for security updates only, see .github/dependabot.yml: one tool opens the routine PRs, so there are never two PRs for the same bump.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Actions are pinned to a commit SHA (config:best-practices); one weekly PR for all of them.
Tooling the CI uses to check and preview the package. It never ships.
The benchmark contenders are not part of the package: monthly, and kept apart from the tooling.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month
